title: States as chips
description: State labels render as chips (background/border) rather than plain mono text. ABORDANDO becomes a soft amber-tint filled chip, PRÓXIMO becomes a bordered outline chip, and SALIENDO becomes a solid-bordered amber-dot chip. Reinforces state as a distinct UI object rather than inline text, using only existing amber tones at different opacities.
baseline_ref: .arrival-row__state and .arrival-row__departing render as plain inline mono text with no background/border

changes.intent: ABORDANDO as a soft amber-tint filled chip.
PRÓXIMO as a bordered outline chip, lighter weight than ABORDANDO's filled chip.
SALIENDO as a solid amber-dot chip, the strongest of the three treatments.
